text: NEWS RELEASE - FOR IMMEDIATE RELEASE Idaho Water Resource Board contact: Neeley Miller, Neeley.Miller@idwr.idaho.gov; 208-287-4800 IWRB awards 13 flood management grants statewide in fiscal 2027 REXBURG - (Aug. 7, 2026) – The Idaho Water Resource Board voted to approve 13 flood management grants statewide for $1.1 million on Friday as part its regular bimonthly meeting here in Rexburg, Idaho. The project awards were as follows: The total project cost of the 13 projects is $2.6 million. The IWRB flood grants will assist the grantees with a variety of projects to repair resources damaged by floods, washouts and other issues. The State Flood Management Grant program is managed by the Idaho Water Resource Board. About $1 million available for funding each year for eligible projects statewide. The flood grant program is open to flood control districts, drainage districts, irrigation districts, canal companies, municipalities, counties, Soil and Water Conservation Districts, and other public entities that may have incurred flood damage in recent times. The maximum budget for each project is $200,000; a 50 percent local match is required. In general, eligible projects include repairing stream channels damaged by floods, streambank repairs, stream-channel improvement, flood-risk reduction, and flood-prevention projects. See application guidelines and details on grant evaluation criteria on the Finance page on the IWRB website. ################################
